name: FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade: Ratio Z-Score with Copper/Gold Regime
description: Pairs trading research for FCX (copper miner) vs NEM (gold miner). Computes the price ratio FCX/NEM, applies a 90-day z-score, and measures mean reversion returns at 5d/10d/20d horizons when the z-score hits ±2.0 extremes. Adds a copper-to-gold regime indicator (HG/GC continuous futures ratio vs its 200d MA): copper-favorable = HG/GC above 200d MA, gold-favorable = below. Shows how mean reversion signal performance differs by regime. Outputs: (1) ratio time series with ±2σ bands, (2) event markers with regime badge, (3) regime-split forward return bars, (4) summary statistics by regime.
source:
# FCX vs NEM Pairs Trade — Price Ratio Z-Score & Mean Reversion
# Signal: 90-day z-score of FCX/NEM price ratio at ±2.0 extremes
# Measures: forward ratio change at 5d, 10d, 20d after extreme signals

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
nem = reference_stocks(ticker='NEM')()
ts = index().value

fcx_close = src.c
nem_close = ffill(nem.c)

# --- Copper/Gold Regime Indicator (HG/GC ratio vs 200d MA) ---
hg_raw = reference_futures(ticker='HG')()
hg = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(hg_raw.o, hg_raw.h, hg_raw.l, hg_raw.c, hg_raw.v, hg_raw.oi, hg_raw.s)

gc_raw = reference_futures(ticker='GC')()
gc = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(gc_raw.o, gc_raw.h, gc_raw.l, gc_raw.c, gc_raw.v, gc_raw.oi, gc_raw.s)

hg_close = ffill(hg.c)
gc_close = ffill(gc.c)
cu_gold_ratio = hg_close / gc_close
cu_gold_ma200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(cu_gold_ratio).result

# Regime: copper-favorable when HG/GC > 200d MA
is_cu_favorable = is_valid(cu_gold_ma200) and cu_gold_ratio > cu_gold_ma200
regime_label = "Copper-Favorable" if is_cu_favorable else "Gold-Favorable"

# --- Price Ratio ---
ratio = fcx_close / nem_close

# --- Z-Score (90-day) and Bands ---
z = zscore(window=90)(ratio).result
z_mean = ma(period=90, type=MAType.sma)(ratio).result
z_std = stddev(period=90)(ratio).result
upper_band = z_mean + 2.0 * z_std
lower_band = z_mean - 2.0 * z_std

# --- Extreme Signal Detection (manual crossover/crossunder — builtin not available) ---
# Rich: z crosses ABOVE +2.0 → expect ratio to fall (short ratio)
z_prev = z >> 1
is_rich = (z > 2.0) and (z_prev <= 2.0)
# Cheap: z crosses BELOW -2.0 → expect ratio to rise (long ratio)
is_cheap = (z < -2.0) and (z_prev >= -2.0)

# --- Forward Ratio Returns (parenthesized for correct precedence) ---
ratio_fwd_5 = ratio << 5
ratio_fwd_10 = ratio << 10
ratio_fwd_20 = ratio << 20
fwd_5d = (ratio_fwd_5 - ratio) / ratio
fwd_10d = (ratio_fwd_10 - ratio) / ratio
fwd_20d = (ratio_fwd_20 - ratio) / ratio

# Filter forward returns to signal bars only
# Rich signals: expect NEGATIVE ratio return → flip sign so positive = correct reversion
rich_fwd_5d = where(is_rich, fwd_5d * -1.0)
rich_fwd_10d = where(is_rich, fwd_10d * -1.0)
rich_fwd_20d = where(is_rich, fwd_20d * -1.0)

# Cheap signals: expect POSITIVE ratio return
cheap_fwd_5d = where(is_cheap, fwd_5d)
cheap_fwd_10d = where(is_cheap, fwd_10d)
cheap_fwd_20d = where(is_cheap, fwd_20d)

# Combined: all signals, direction-adjusted (positive = correct reversion)
all_fwd_5d = coalesce(rich_fwd_5d, cheap_fwd_5d)
all_fwd_10d = coalesce(rich_fwd_10d, cheap_fwd_10d)
all_fwd_20d = coalesce(rich_fwd_20d, cheap_fwd_20d)

# --- Signal Labels ---
is_signal = is_rich or is_cheap
signal_type = conditional_select(is_rich, "Rich (Short Ratio)", is_cheap, "Cheap (Long Ratio)", "None")

# --- Regime-Split Forward Returns ---
# Copper-favorable regime signals
cu_fwd_5d = where(is_signal and is_cu_favorable, all_fwd_5d)
cu_fwd_10d = where(is_signal and is_cu_favorable, all_fwd_10d)
cu_fwd_20d = where(is_signal and is_cu_favorable, all_fwd_20d)

# Gold-favorable regime signals
au_fwd_5d = where(is_signal and (not is_cu_favorable), all_fwd_5d)
au_fwd_10d = where(is_signal and (not is_cu_favorable), all_fwd_10d)
au_fwd_20d = where(is_signal and (not is_cu_favorable), all_fwd_20d)

# Hit rates by regime
cu_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(cu_fwd_5d) and cu_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(cu_fwd_5d) else cu_fwd_5d)
cu_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(cu_fwd_10d) and cu_fwd_10d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(cu_fwd_10d) else cu_fwd_10d)
cu_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(cu_fwd_20d) and cu_fwd_20d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(cu_fwd_20d) else cu_fwd_20d)
au_hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(au_fwd_5d) and au_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(au_fwd_5d) else au_fwd_5d)
au_hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(au_fwd_10d) and au_fwd_10d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(au_fwd_10d) else au_fwd_10d)
au_hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(au_fwd_20d) and au_fwd_20d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(au_fwd_20d) else au_fwd_20d)

# --- Hit Rate (ternary for correct calc per S02/S41) ---
hit_5d = 1.0 if (is_valid(all_fwd_5d) and all_fwd_5d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(all_fwd_5d) else all_fwd_5d)
hit_10d = 1.0 if (is_valid(all_fwd_10d) and all_fwd_10d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(all_fwd_10d) else all_fwd_10d)
hit_20d = 1.0 if (is_valid(all_fwd_20d) and all_fwd_20d > 0) else (0.0 if is_valid(all_fwd_20d) else all_fwd_20d)

# --- Output 1: Ratio with Z-Score Bands ---
xy_lines(
    title='FCX/NEM Price Ratio with 90d Mean & 2-Sigma Bands',
    category='Pairs Trade',
    y_axis_label='Price Ratio',
    y_axis_dp=3,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='FCX/NEM Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='90d Mean', color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Upper Band (+2s)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Lower Band (-2s)', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=(ratio, z_mean, upper_band, lower_band))

# --- Output 2: Event Markers at Extreme Z-Score Signals (with regime badge) ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Ratio Z-Score Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Signal', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.SecondaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Ratio', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='20d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(signal_type, regime_label, z, ratio, all_fwd_20d, is_signal)

# --- Output 3: Regime-Split Mean Reversion Returns ---
# Grouped bars: Copper-Favorable vs Gold-Favorable stacks at each horizon
# Same series names across stacks per R11
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does Regime Matter? Median Reversion Return by HG/GC Regime',
    category='Pairs Trade',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Median Direction-Adjusted Return',
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper-Favorable'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper-Favorable'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Blue, stack='Copper-Favorable'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Gold-Favorable'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Gold-Favorable'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+20d', color=Color.Slate, stack='Gold-Favorable')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(cu_fwd_5d, cu_fwd_10d, cu_fwd_20d, au_fwd_5d, au_fwd_10d, au_fwd_20d))

# --- Output 4: Regime-Split Summary Statistics ---
# 4 rows x 6 cols: Cu-Fav (+5d/+10d/+20d) | Au-Fav (+5d/+10d/+20d)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Signal Stats by HG/GC Regime (Direction-Adjusted)',
        row_size=4,
        col_size=6,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Median Return', 'Hit Rate', 'Best'],
        col_headers=['Cu +5d', 'Cu +10d', 'Cu +20d', 'Au +5d', 'Au +10d', 'Au +20d'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: Event Count
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Median Return
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            # Row 2: Hit Rate
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            # Row 3: Best
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=5, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Pairs Trade',
    order=3
)(cu_fwd_5d, cu_fwd_10d, cu_fwd_20d, au_fwd_5d, au_fwd_10d, au_fwd_20d, cu_fwd_5d, cu_fwd_10d, cu_fwd_20d, au_fwd_5d, au_fwd_10d, au_fwd_20d, cu_hit_5d, cu_hit_10d, cu_hit_20d, au_hit_5d, au_hit_10d, au_hit_20d, cu_fwd_5d, cu_fwd_10d, cu_fwd_20d, au_fwd_5d, au_fwd_10d, au_fwd_20d)
